# ENV/SERVICES

> Training for hazardous waste field technicians: HAZWOPER and RCRA waste technician, 24-hour TSD operations, TSD refresher and manifests.

ENV/SERVICES (https://environmental-services.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs Waste Technician, 24-Hr TSD Operations, 8-Hr TSD Refresher, Manifest training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://environmental-services.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

Combined HAZWOPER and RCRA training for hazardous waste management technicians. The 24-hour HAZWOPER for work at your company's permitted TSD facility. Enroll: https://environmental-services.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-24-hour-hazwoper-rcra-tsd-operations-training?buy=582
- [OSHA 8 Hour HAZWOPER Annual Refresher - RCRA TSD Operations Training](https://environmental-services.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-annual-refresher-rcra-tsd-operations-training): $89.99 per seat, 8 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(p)(8) / RCRA. ## Guides

- [Lab packing safely: a field tech's checklist](https://environmental-services.hazwoperosha.us/guides/lab-packing-safely): Lab packs look simple: small bottles in a drum. Getting them wrong can start a fire in the truck.
- [Chemical compatibility when consolidating waste](https://environmental-services.hazwoperosha.us/guides/compatibility-when-consolidating-waste): Bulking drums saves money. Mixing the wrong two saves nothing. How techs check compatibility.
- [The waste technician training path](https://environmental-services.hazwoperosha.us/guides/waste-technician-training-path): From new hire to lead tech: the certificates field techs usually build up, in order.
